execution: decentralized: each trained node has its own actor network (no parameter sharing), whose input is the node's local view and a one-hot node identifier (E12's local view); one centralized critic whose input is the full global state and the node identifier
optimizer: separate actor and critic Adam, no gradient clipping (E7's separate_no_clip learner), raw rewards

critic_modes.M: the plain head with its output fixed-scaled, V = c * head(x), c = 1 (B) or 7 (S), as X4's part M

inference: seed-level jackknife-t over 40 seeds, t(39), primary at 95%; equivalence by the 90% jackknife-t interval within the declared margin; seed-block percentile bootstrap (2,000 draws, seed 20261123) secondary
gate: 1: index 0 run twice is bit-identical (evaluation, every minibatch record, X5 log); 2: part M arm B (c=1) reproduces part plain arm B bit-for-bit on the same seed and w, including the X5 log; 3: logging is RNG-neutral: plain arm B with and without logging gives bit-identical evaluation and minibatch records; 4: the independence check passes (actor parameter sets per node are disjoint, a node's actor receives zero gradient from other nodes' samples, the critic's input contains no local-only entries); 5: indices 0, 640 and 1280 complete with 469 X5 records
